Method of Attack: Injecting a malicious JavaScript script into the checkout page to steal customer payment and contact information
Stealing credit card details, billing addresses, email addresses, and telephone numbers by sending collected data to a remote server
Attack Vector: Injected JavaScript script loaded from https://js-cloud.com/js/static.js into the checkout page
Indicators of Compromise: Injected script found in Archive.org snapshot from June 9, 2017
Presence of Russian https://top.mail.ru/ tracking script on checkout page as of December 12, 2018
